title: How Are You
description: "how are you?" set in a real pixel typeface in electric blue on grey, four times over, each line more broken than the last and quietly shifting on its own. Drag a line down and its pixels drop out and slip a cell at a time; drag up and it heals; scrub across to wear it away and hold still to mend it.
intent: Decay as a stepped property of a true bitmap font: Pixelify Sans glyphs are sampled onto their own pixel grid and set tight, and short runs of cells drop out or slip one cell along their row or column, so the wear stays crisp and reversible.
sources: herb reference board: 4090d1d5 "how are you?" electric-blue bitmap type decaying line by line
